title: Supremath — Suprematism Art Generator
excerpt: Generate endless Malevich-style Suprematist compositions in your browser. Every picture is numbered, shareable by link and downloadable as PNG or SVG.
content_html: Supremath is a small homage to Suprematism, the art of pure shapes and color that Kazimir Malevich launched in 1915. Every composition is built live by a generator that follows a reading of what makes a Suprematist picture — one dominant form, balance without symmetry, a shared tilt, a few free accents — and checks each one against those rules before showing it.
